title: The Spirit Carries On - Dream Theater (Metropolis Pt. 2, 1999)
notes: AI interpretation from general knowledge of the record, not from listening: an acoustic-style part, a Mesa Rectifier rhythm at moderate gain, and a singing Mesa Mark lead with delay and a big reverb, in the spirit of Petrucci's rig of that era. Patch 1 uses the acoustic simulator without an amp; it sounds best with GLOBAL OUTPUT set to DIRECT. Tempo not verified, so delay times are moderate.

patches.name: SPIRIT AC
patches.notes: Acoustic part: compressor, acoustic simulator (no amp), a touch of stereo chorus for width, hall.

patches.name: SPIRIT RHY
patches.notes: Rhythm: Dual Rectifier at moderate gain, tightened by a low-gain Tube Screamer, small room.

patches.name: SPIRIT SOL
patches.notes: Solo: boosted Mesa Mark-style lead for long sustain, clear delay and a big reverb; louder than the rhythm.
